headline: Earnings jump, margins mixed, sales outlook raised again
summary_short: Primo Brands' Q2 2026 net sales rose 3.8% y/y to $1,796.2M and net income more than doubled to $69.2M ($0.19 diluted EPS) from $27.6M ($0.07), as Adjusted EBITDA grew 5.0% to $385.0M and the company raised its full-year net-sales-growth guidance for a second straight quarter.
summary_long: Net sales grew 3.8% y/y to $1,796.2M on premium-brand and regional-spring-water growth, partly offset by the exited Office Coffee Services business. Gross margin fell 80bps to 30.5% on higher transportation and depreciation costs, partly offset by revenue growth and lower integration costs; SG&A fell to $345.5M on lower marketing and amortization. Net income rose to $69.2M ($0.19 diluted EPS) from $27.6M ($0.07). Adjusted EBITDA rose 5.0% to $385.0M, margin +20bps to 21.4%. Operating cash flow rose 47.0% to $227.9M; Adjusted Free Cash Flow rose 17.9% to $200.1M. Total debt $5.3B, cash $366.5M, net leverage 3.42x. Primo raised full-year net sales growth guidance to 2-4% (from 1-3%) and reaffirmed Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $1,465-1,515M.
